abstract: Maintains physical quayside construction specifications and length metrics
system_message:
You are Civil infrastructure development lead (CIV). The Civil infrastructure development lead (CIV) oversees physical quayside construction specifications and length metrics, and tracks maintenance dredging operational schedules across port facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintenance dredging schedule（DRAG）
information_points.content:
CIV-DRAG-EFK：As logged in the marine management license registry, Tees Integrated Marine Terminal holds a dredged material disposal license duration with a remaining validity period of 36 months at its licensed offshore spoil disposal ground.
CIV-DRAG-0RB：Records from the marine management license registry show that Tyne Renewable Energy Park maintains a dredged material disposal license duration of 24 months for its licensed offshore spoil disposal ground.
CIV-DRAG-U9H：Per the marine management license registry for the licensed offshore spoil disposal ground, the dredged material disposal license duration for Humber Deepwater Outer Basin has 12 months of remaining validity.

information_points.title: Maintains physical quayside construction specifications and length metrics（QUAY）
information_points.content:
CIV-QUAY-HE3：Based on the quayside civil engineering survey, Tees Integrated Marine Terminal possesses a total continuous heavy-lift quayside length of 760 m on its continuous reinforced concrete quay structure engineered to heavy-lift surcharge rating.
CIV-QUAY-V68：The quayside civil engineering survey indicates that Tyne Renewable Energy Park has a total continuous heavy-lift quayside length of 620 m along its continuous reinforced concrete quay structure engineered to heavy-lift surcharge rating.
CIV-QUAY-Q7H：According to the quayside civil engineering survey, Humber Deepwater Outer Basin features a total continuous heavy-lift quayside length of 480 m across its continuous reinforced concrete quay structure engineered to heavy-lift surcharge rating.
